specs.Item Type Name: Zebronics Sound Feast 90, 8W RMS with Bluetooth v5.0, USB & mSD Support, FM Radio, AUX Input, TWS Function, Media Control, LED Lights

features: 10W RMS AUDIO: Fill your space with rich, engaging sound through 10W RMS output and a 10.16cm driver that adds depth to your music.
EXTENDED PLAYBACK: Keep the tunes flowing for up to 3 hours (at 50% volume, LED off), powered by a built-in rechargeable battery with Type-C charging.
WIDER TWS SOUND: Double up the audio with TWS functionality that pairs two compatible speakers for a broader, more dynamic sound experience.
VERSATILE PLAYBACK: Switch between BT v5.0, USB, and mSD connectivity for flexible access to your favourite tracks and playlists.
KARAOKE ENTERTAINMENT: Bring more energy to gatherings with a 6.3mm microphone input and wired mic support, ideal for lively karaoke and performances.
BUILT-IN FM RADIO: Tune into your favourite stations with the built-in FM radio for convenient access to music, shows, and broadcasts.
INTUITIVE CONTROLS: Manage your audio with convenient media and volume controls for quick, effortless command over your listening experience.
PORTABLE CONVENIENCE: Keep your smartphone handy with the integrated mobile holder and carry the speaker easily with the convenient carry handle.
